sources.title: Lordnyx/qwen3.5-9b-triple-loop-fase1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B Triple-Loop (Phase 1) An experimental fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B using LoopSplit: the middle transformer layers are executed three times in a row, sharing the same weights, then the model is distilled against a stronger teacher's logits so it learns to make use of the extra passes. This mirrors an earlier LoopSplit experiment on Qwen3-0.6B, scaled up to 9B with a hybrid Gated ...

sources.title: Hobbyist builds Qwen3.5-9B triple-loop model inspired by Nanbeige 4.5
sources.snippet: Prototype applies a triple loop in middle layers, inspired by Nanbeige 4.5 architecture paper. Initial dual-loop version on Qwen3-0.6B preceded the triple-loop attempt. Model released on Hugging Face as Lordnyx /qwen3.5- 9b -triple-loop-fase1. Author describes the project as 'for fun' and motivated by Nanbeige 's performance per parameter.
